states: Private mock stack (8 nodes, mock TrueNAS truenas-main) with a local-only generator overlay pinning TrueNAS disk temperatures: nvme0n1 60C, nvme1n1 72C, sda 57C (SATA), sdc 63C (SAS); after = this branch, before = main logic in the same tree

Thresholds > TrueNAS > Disks with no saved TrueNAS-wide value: header reads 'Defaults: NVMe 70°C · SAS 65°C · SATA 55°C', note 'Unless set here, each disk alerts at Disk temperature by type, set under Agents.', Global Defaults Temp cell empty with placeholder 'By type' (fits after widening to w-20) and On, disk rows nvme0n1/nvme1n1 70°C, sda/sdb 55°C, sdc-sdf 65°C
Same section at 375px: Global Defaults card shows TEMP °C 'By type' with On, disk cards show their type triggers, no horizontal overflow

Agent Disk Temp default switched off through the API: header 'Defaults: all metric alerts off', Global Defaults cell Off with title 'Off because the agent Disk Temp default under Agents is off...', disk rows Off

Saved TrueNAS-wide 62: header 'Defaults: Temp 62°C', every disk row 62°C, Custom badge and reset control after reload; saved 55 survives save and reload as 55 (stored with truenasDiskTemperatureByType)

Alerts with factory per-type thresholds: after stack raises nvme1n1 72 (trigger 70) and sda 57 (trigger 55) with diskType metadata, none for nvme0n1 60 or sdc 63; before (main) raised all four at a flat 55
TrueNAS storage table agrees: Attention 'Disk temperature is 72°C, at or above its 70°C alert threshold.' on nvme1n1 and '57°C ... 55°C' on sda, none on nvme0n1

TrueNAS disk drawer (Platform details > Show TrueNAS > Health): nvme0n1 Temperature 60°C in default text colour (main toned it amber from the fixed 55C); sda 57°C amber rgb(252,211,77) at 1366 and at 375 with no overflow
interactions: Typed 62 into the TrueNAS Disks Global Defaults Temp cell, saved, reloaded: API truenasDiskDefaults {trigger 62, clear 57}, cell shows 62 with Custom
Triple-clicked and typed 55, saved, reloaded: API keeps {55, 50}, cell shows 55 with Custom and the reset control
Clicked Reset to factory defaults: cell returns to 'By type'; saved: API truenasDiskDefaults {}
On the 375px card, clicked On to switch the default Off, saved: API stores {trigger 0, clear 0} and the after stack's TrueNAS disk alerts resolve; clicked again: returns to 'By type', saved: {}
With the agent Disk Temp default off, clicked the Off badge: stages an explicit 55 (Custom, rows 55°C); discarded
Loaded an old saved config (flat 55/50, no marker) with the new binary: GET returns truenasDiskDefaults {} and truenasDiskTemperatureByType true
Expanded nvme0n1 and sda rows on /truenas/storage, opened Platform details and Show TrueNAS, read the Temperature row value and computed colour at 1366 and 375
